identity.description: An attacker uses the Windows MOF compiler (mofcomp.exe) to install a malicious WMI class, enabling persistence and execution of malicious code. Cortex should detect the unusual usage of mofcomp.exe with a .mof file.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon MOF Compiler Usage
biocs.description: Detection of mofcomp.exe being invoked with a .mof file that is not part of standard Windows components
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mofcomp.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.mof'
| filter not action_file_path contains 'Windows\System32\wbem'
